reading.title: The Art of the Balanced Pivot
reading.introduction: Welcome to your reading. Let us take a gentle, clear-eyed look at where you stand right now without any unnecessary pressure.

cards.title: Two of Swords
cards.interpretation: You are currently holding a delicate stalemate, weighing competing ideas and difficult truths as if deciding which alarm clock to gently toss out the window.
cards.pop_culture: Like Neo trying to pick between the red pill and the blue pill while experiencing a mild existential crisis.

cards.title: Justice
cards.interpretation: A sense of accountability is stepping into the room, asking you to own your role in the equilibrium and look closely at the long-term consequences of your choices.
cards.pop_culture: Reminiscent of Elle Woods walking into the courtroom in her pink suit and completely rearranging the logic of the case through sheer preparation.

cards.title: Eight of Pentacles
cards.interpretation: Your path forward is rooted in steady, repetitive, and satisfying craftsmanship where daily work and practical care finally start to compound.
cards.pop_culture: Channeling Leslie Knope meticulously color-coding a binder because the joy is truly in the execution of the task.

reading.next_step: Spend ten minutes today writing down just one practical priority for your workspace and take the first small action toward it.
